# Original Name equality rows

Two authentic Lean4.33.1 rows, unchanged except optional top-level pretty text:
Lean.Name.beq / lean_name_eq and its genuine owned ._boxed wrapper. Per-record
raw SHA and derived fixture SHA have distinct meanings. These rows form the
complete wrapper's static FAP dependency closure. Source research does not
constitute executed compatibility evidence.
